facts.fact: Loi de finances n°25/060 appropriates FC 53,840,917,417 of domestic state money to section 52 Postes et Télécommunications for 2026 (section total FC 55,095,958,006 less FC 1,255,040,589 external investment); the section is multi-purpose and the NTIC mandate was moved out of it.
Section 52 (formerly Postes, Télécommunications et NTIC) fell from FC 145,650,630,007 in 2025 to FC 55,095,958,006 in 2026 (-62%), largely because the ICT mandate moved to section 71.
facts.system: Section 52 Postes et Télécommunications, budget 2026 against 2025

facts.fact: Section 71 Économie numérique (formerly Numérique) is given FC 226,713,223,741 for 2026 in the same finance law, as the document reports.
Section 71 rose from FC 60,627,481,411 in 2025 to FC 226,713,223,741 in 2026 (+274%), which the document says is substantially a transfer of the ICT mandate from section 52, not new money.

note: Section 71 figures are quoted in the document's notes rather than its tables; combined sections 52 and 71 went from FC 206,278,111,418 (2025) to FC 281,809,181,747 (2026).
